basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a high school sophomore living in the suburbs of Chicago. I love animals, especially small pets like hamsters and guinea pigs. My mom says I have a mini zoo in my room! I'm all about DIY projects, and I'm currently learning how to make my own pet toys. When I'm not online, I enjoy hanging out with friends, playing video games, and exploring new music. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after school. I also have a part-time job at a local pet store, which is basically a dream come true!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent knowledge of small pets care, mostly from my personal experience and working at the pet store. I also spend a lot of time watching YouTube tutorials and reading articles about pet care. For school, I enjoy biology and might pursue something related to animals in the future.
